- **Biosphère (Parc Jean-Drapeau):** The operator's page lists December hours. 
Sunday, December 27 · 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Monday, December 28 · Closed; Tuesday, December 29 · 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Wednesday, December 30 · 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
 The page says nothing about who it suits, so I can't give a toddler `age_fit` without making one up.
- **Biodôme and Insectarium (Espace pour la vie):** The operator's hours page I reached only showed weeks in late September and early October. 
Week of September 28, 2026
 was the first one shown, so I couldn't confirm hours for Dec 27 to 30. The only holiday-hours page from the operator was years old. The other Biodôme hours pages were third-party sites, not the venue's own page.
- **Montréal Science Centre:** Its own holiday-hours page is old and refers to earlier years. The regular hours on its visitor page are 
Monday through Friday 9 a.m. – 4 p.m., and Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m. – 5 p.m.
 I found no 2026 holiday schedule and no toddler-specific information.
- **Musée pour enfants (Laval):** The operator says it was 
made for children of 2 to 8 years
, but it is in Laval, not Montréal. I found no hours for those dates, so I left it out.

The Biosphère, Biodôme and Science Centre are the leads to check once their holiday hours post. Their own pages are the place to confirm Dec 27 to 30 hours and toddler suitability.
